era: visual novel tactical RPG / action RPG
summary: Aquaplus' Utawarerumono series blends story-heavy visual novel structure with tactical RPG battles, later expanding into action spin-offs, mobile side stories, and full JRPG sequels.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Prelude to the Fallen

primary.why: Prelude to the Fallen is the modern title for the first game; the PC release is the official English, current, and most capture-friendly route, while the original adult Windows release is historically different but not the practical main-play version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. For strict historical comparison, document the 2002 adult Windows original separately rather than replacing the main run.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original 2002 adult Windows release content removed from later console/remake releases.
secondary.what_to_play: Historical comparison only; the modern Steam remake remains the main run.
secondary.why: The 2002 Windows release was an adult game; later releases removed the adult content.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remake/localized versions are not identical to the original adult Windows release.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception

primary.why: Mask of Deception shipped on PS3, PS4, Vita, and later Windows; the Steam release is the current PC route and the easiest high-fidelity capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. PS4 is a fine console alternative, but PC is the preferred archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: RPG Site criticized the PC ports' text/rendering quality, so test readability before capture.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth

primary.why: Mask of Truth shipped on PS3, PS4, Vita, and later Windows; the Steam release is the current PC route and the easiest high-fidelity capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches after finishing Prelude and Mask of Deception. PS4 is the console alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: RPG Site criticized the PC ports' text/rendering quality, so test readability before capture.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Zan

primary.why: Zan began as a PS4 action spin-off and later received a PC release; the PC version is the best current capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. PS4 remains the original console route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Action spin-off retelling of Mask of Deception events, not a replacement for the visual novel/tactical RPG.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Lost Flag
entries.definitive_edition: Original mobile service; Story Archives pending

emulation.emulator: Android device/emulator only if archived client access is legitimate
emulation.notes: Live service has ended; rely on official offline archive if released.

primary.version: Original Japanese mobile service / preservation pending
primary.why: Lost Flag was the series' iOS/Android mobile RPG, but service ended on April 23, 2026; an offline Story Archives version has been announced but was not yet a normal replacement route at the time of research.
primary.how_to_play: No active live-service play route remains. Preserve through official story archive coverage when Aquaplus releases the offline version, or use recorded footage/documentation for now.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service ended April 23, 2026; do not plan a normal playthrough unless the offline archive is released and complete.

entries.title: Dokapon UP! Mugen no Roulette

emulation.notes: Use PS4 hardware or PS5 backward compatibility.

primary.why: This Dokapon/Utawarerumono crossover shipped on PS4 and Switch in Japan; PS4 is the better capture route for a TV/stream setup.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PS4 release on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Switch is the portable/party alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japanese-only crossover; not a replacement for the Utawarerumono story RPGs.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Zan 2

primary.why: Zan 2 launched on PS4/PS5 in Japan and later received an English PC release with PC-specific enhancements, making Steam the best current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. Use the console versions only for original Japanese hardware context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Action spin-off covering Mask of Truth events, not a replacement for the tactical/visual-novel game.

entries.title: Gizoku Tantei Nosuri

emulation.notes: Use PS4 hardware or PS5 backward compatibility.

primary.why: The Nosuri detective spin-off was announced for PS4 and Switch as a Japan-only digital visual novel; PS4 is the cleaner TV/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PS4 digital release on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use translation aids if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japan-only visual-novel spin-off; availability should be checked before planning a stream.

entries.title: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten

primary.why: Monochrome Mobius launched on PS4/PS5 in Japan and PC worldwide, later adding western PlayStation and Switch 2 routes; PC remains the best capture/settings route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. PS5 is the best console alternative; Switch 2 is the portable/console hybrid route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch 2 availability is a later Japan console route; PC remains the practical worldwide path.

entries.title: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered

primary.why: Past and Present Rediscovered launched on PS5 and Switch 2 in Japan and on PC worldwide; the Steam release is the best English/worldwide and capture-friendly route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with current patches. Use PS5 or Switch 2 only for the Japanese console versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: New 2026 release; verify patch state before a full archive playthrough.
